description: Publish an approved post immediately. Agents get a two-step: the first call returns CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with a confirm_token; ask the user, then call again with it.

account_ids.description: Only these accounts' targets. Default: all.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

post_id.description: ID of the post (a UUID): from post_list or post_create

name: post_publish_now
title: Publish now
